experiments.scope: Rounds 4, blake3-r4-prefix-v1. Re-executes the embedded generator and ledger of this package (gate count, program sha256, score), advances one batch of the emitted net against its scalar reference, accounts the memory as implemented (allocated 4-byte gate records, a real 65,536 x 8-byte slot table filled with 35,000 entries, peak live planes). Per trial it derives start points from the organizer seed, evaluates them with the emitted bit-sliced net (not the scalar reference), and returns two distinct 64-byte messages whose complete digests agree on the low 8 bits. Scope limit: the masked-agreement pairs and the full-width table probe test the circuit, the table mechanics and the pair search; they do not measure the width-256 collision probability or the attack cost, and no iid, probability or cost inference is claimed from them.
experiments.hypothesis: The package is self-reproducing: the shipped sources rebuild the emitted program and the ledger rows exactly, the emitted program evaluates the selected target, its packed image and table fit the memory row, and a seeded batched search driven by the emitted net returns real agreeing pairs on that target.
